The vendor's words describe the tool as absent; the wire shows the request refused.

finding: A keyless tools/list sent to https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp with the vendor's own 'enable all tools' URL parameter (tools=web_search_exa,web_fetch_exa,web_search_advanced_exa,agent_run) answered HTTP 401 on 2026-10-03 at 18:09:55Z with JSON-RPC error -32000 'Authentication required. Use OAuth or provide an API key.' and a WWW-Authenticate challenge of the bearer scheme whose resource_metadata parameter names the server's RFC 9728 document (read 200 on 2026-10-04: authorization server auth.exa.ai, scope mcp:tools). The vendor's page says agent_run only appears once the caller is authenticated; measured, asking for it by name turns the whole handshake into a refusal rather than a shorter list. The same request without agent_run in the parameter answered 200 with three tools (the advanced record), so the one name is what draws the 401. Corrected 2026-10-04: the first version of this record said no challenge header was served; the artifact showed one, and the re-run confirmed it.
